meta.description: Dealing with delayed DOM generation, lazy loading, and optimistic state synchronization in vanilla JavaScript without a reactive framework.

copy.tagline: 解决无框架环境下的 DOM 竞态与延迟更新问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目未使用前端框架，却要处理复杂的 UI 状态同步
copy.tagline_en: Handle DOM race conditions and delayed updates in plain JavaScript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work without a framework and need to manage UI state sync issues

howto.what: 当用户询问原生JavaScript页面中界面组件不显示、闪烁或事件监听不触发等问题时，Claude会提供应对DOM竞态和乐观更新陷阱的代码解决方案，包括递归轮询绑定事件和多源状态判定降级。
howto.when: 当用户描述或抱怨原生JavaScript应用中因延迟DOM生成、懒加载或乐观状态同步导致的界面问题（如侧边栏不显示、闪烁、事件不触发）时触发。

say.text: 我的侧边栏初次加载时不显示，但手动交互后能弹出，怎么办？
say.note: Claude会给出递归轮询绑定事件的代码示例。

say.text: 界面在开启和关闭之间闪烁，如何修复？
say.note: Claude会演示多源状态判定降级的方法。

say.text: 绑定在DOM上的事件监听器没触发，怎么解决？

howto.what_en: When users ask about UI components not showing, flickering, or event listeners not firing in vanilla JavaScript pages, Claude provides code solutions for DOM race conditions and optimistic update pitfalls, including recursive polling for event binding and multi-source state judgment fallback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users describe or complain about UI issues in vanilla JavaScript apps caused by delayed DOM generation, lazy loading, or optimistic state synchronization, such as sidebar not showing, flickering, or events not firing.

say_en.text: My sidebar doesn't show on the first load but appears after manual interaction. What should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will provide a recursive polling code example for event binding.

say_en.text: The UI flickers when opening and closing. How can I fix it?
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate the multi-source state judgment fallback method.

say_en.text: Event listeners bound to DOM elements are not triggered. How to solve?
say_en.note: Claude will explain using self-terminating polling instead of fixed setTimeout.
